##### Summary

- Fixes #7676  support specify destination hostname in remote backend
- Fixes #7678 Support send host/chart variables in remote backend
- Support filter host/chart variables with `send charts matching`

##### Component Name

Backend

##### Additional Information
pr_comments:
Manage this branch in Squash

Test this branch here: https://ehekatltmp-remote-write-0v625.squash.io

This pull request **introduces 1 alert** when merging 169a99413b269432d323aa289b3c54640d151736 into e45f970ad67ed77a2b03e4f4734c413888013a72 - [view on LGTM.com](https://lgtm.com/projects/g/netdata/netdata/rev/pr-c22129b699f1e35caaf58c54c1f3ec6926847d01)

**new alerts:**

* 1 for Badly bounded write

As for the `simple_pattern_matches`, I think it's too much for a huge amount of variables we have in the database. It's also misleading, because `send charts matching` means _charts_ not _charts and variables_. We already have the `variables` option in the `allmetrics` API call, and I think we don't need an additional filter. For the remote write backend, you can add a similar option in the `backend` section, let's name it `expose variables`.

@vlvkobal Ya this pr is very hacky.
 the filter is ugly because I can't set flag on variables.

Let me explain what's this for
I'm very happy with all other variables, except the nic_speed one (which was added by myself😭
That was a convenient trick to calculate bandwidth alarm.

However, variables don't have dimension, so each interface result in a different variable name.
In the end we have massive labels polluting our tsdb.

I believe a better way to support this would be extend variable to have flag and dimension.

> I believe a better way to support this would be extend variable to have flag and dimension.

We are going already the [other way](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/issues/7730). I believe _Static system information_ and _labels_ could solve the problem with the `nic_speed`.

A the moment I suggest simplifying the PR - removing the `simple_pattern_matches` and adding the `expose variables` for the remote write.

All committers have signed the CLA.
@Ehekatl Hi. Do you plan to finish the PR?

I'm closing the PR - it is outdated. We moved to the exporting engine and the backends subsystem will be deleted soon. The only thing that could be implemented in the exporting engine is variables in remote write so #7678 will still be open.
